name: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality
notes: THE key source for the SSM hardware problem. States directly that SSD 'thanks to its reformulation to use matrix multiplication as a subroutine, can exploit specialized matrix multiplication (matmul) units on GPUs, also known as tensor cores. As a result, it is 2-8x faster than Mamba's fused associative scan, which does not leverage matmul units.' Chunkwise decomposition of the semiseparable matrix; 8x larger recurrent state with minimal slowdown; crosses FlashAttention-2 at sequence length 2K and is 6x faster at 16K.
